{{Short description|Mathematician (1934–2016)}}
'''Joseph Jonah Rotman''' (May 26, 1934 – October 16, 2016)<ref>[http://www.news-gazette.com/obituaries/2016-10-18/joseph-rotman.html Joseph Rotman (obituary)], [[The News-Gazette (Champaign-Urbana)|The News-Gazette]], Tuesday, October 18, 2016.</ref> was a professor of [[mathematics]] at the [[University of Illinois at Urbana–Champaign]]<ref name="J. Rotman">{{Cite web |url=http://www.math.uiuc.edu/~rotman/ |title=J. Rotman |publisher=uiuc.edu |accessdate=August 6, 2016}}</ref> and also a published author of 10 textbooks.

Rotman was born in [[Chicago]]. He did his undergraduate and graduate work at the [[University of Chicago]], where he received his doctorate in 1959 with a thesis in [[abelian group]]s written under the direction of [[Irving Kaplansky]].<ref>{{MathGenealogy|822}}</ref> In 1959 he moved to the University of Illinois at Urbana–Champaign, where he spent the rest of his mathematical career. Rotman retired from UIUC in 2004.<ref name=MT /> His research interests lay in the area of [[abstract algebra|algebra]], involving [[abelian groups]], [[Module (mathematics)|modules]], [[homological algebra]], and [[combinatorics]].<ref name="J. Rotman"/>

Rotman was the managing editor of the ''[[Proceedings of the American Mathematical Society]]'' in 1972–1973.<ref name=MT>[http://www.math.uiuc.edu/mathtimes/mathtimes_sp04.pdf Retirements: Joseph Rotman] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161020214108/http://www.math.uiuc.edu/mathtimes/mathtimes_sp04.pdf |date=2016-10-20 }}, Math Times, Spring 2004, p. 9, Department of Mathematics, [[University of Illinois at Urbana–Champaign]].</ref> In 1985 he was the annual visiting lecturer of the [[South African Mathematical Society]].<ref>[http://www.math.illinois.edu/People/facultyhonors.html Faculty honors] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130215002400/http://www.math.illinois.edu/People/facultyhonors.html |date=2013-02-15 }}, Department of Mathematics, [[University of Illinois at Urbana–Champaign]].</ref>

A partial list of Rotman's publications includes:

* ''An Introduction to Homological Algebra'' (1979), Pure and Applied Mathematics, vol. 85, Academic Press; {{ISBN|0-12-599250-5}}<ref name="Lambek1983">{{cite journal|last1=Lambek|first1=J.|authorlink=Joachim Lambek|title=Book Review: ''An introduction to homological algebra''|journal=[[Bulletin of the American Mathematical Society]]|volume=8|issue=2|year=1983|pages=371–376|issn=0273-0979|doi=10.1090/S0273-0979-1983-15128-5|doi-access=free}}</ref>
* ''An Introduction to Algebraic Topology'' (1988),  Springer-Verlag; {{ISBN|0-387-96678-1}}
* ''An Introduction to the Theory of Groups'' (1995),  Springer-Verlag; {{ISBN|0-387-94285-8}}
* ''A First Course in Abstract Algebra'' (2000), Prentice Hall; {{ISBN|0-13-011584-3}} 
* ''Advanced Modern Algebra'' (2002), Prentice Hall; {{ISBN|0-13-087868-5}}
* ''Journey into Mathematics: an introduction to proofs'' (2006), [[Dover Publications]]; {{ISBN|0-486-45306-5}}
